numerical_claims.source_evidence: Calculated as ((539.0 - 310.9) / 539.0) * 100 = 42.3%. Source data from Key Indicators table.

numerical_claims.claim: Total assets of EUR 415.1 million and shareholders' equity of EUR 260.6 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Key Indicators table shows Assets (million EUR) for 2025: 415.1 and Equity (million EUR) for 2025: 260.6.

numerical_claims.claim: Gross profit of EUR 55.9 million with a gross margin of 18.0% (vs 17.8% in 2024).
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Key Indicators table shows Gross profit (million EUR) for 2025: 55.9 and 2024: 95.9. Gross margin calculation: 55.9/310.9 = 18.0% (2025) and 95.9/539.0 = 17.8% (2024).

numerical_claims.claim: Operating profit of EUR 34.3 million (11.0% margin) vs EUR 72.5 million (13.4% margin) in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Key Indicators table shows Operating profit (million EUR) for 2025: 34.3 and 2024: 72.5. Operating margin calculation: 34.3/310.9 = 11.0% (2025) and 72.5/539.0 = 13.4% (2024).

numerical_claims.claim: Net profit attributable to equity holders of EUR 39.9 million (12.8% margin) vs EUR 64.7 million (12.0% margin) in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Key Indicators table shows Net profit (million EUR) for 2025: 39.9 and 2024: 64.7. Net margin calculation: 39.9/310.9 = 12.8% (2025) and 64.7/539.0 = 12.0% (2024).

numerical_claims.claim: Return on equity of 15.6% and equity ratio of 62.8% against a debt ratio of 8.0%.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Key Indicators table shows Return on equity (%) for 2025: 15.6, Equity ratio (%) for 2025: 62.8, and Debt ratio (%) for 2025: 8.0.

numerical_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents of EUR 41.4 million vs EUR 91.9 million in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 14 shows Cash and cash equivalents (thousand EUR) for 2025: 41,424 and 2024: 91,879.

numerical_claims.claim: Real estate development revenue increase to EUR 67.8 million from sale of 358 apartments.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 3 segment data shows Real estate development Revenue (thousand EUR) for 2025: 73,373. Management Report states: 'A total of 358 apartments (incl. 11 apartments in a joint venture) were sold in 2025 at the total value of EUR 67.8 million (excl. VAT)...'

numerical_claims.claim: Real estate segment operating margin decreased to 18.2% from 25.5%.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 3 segment data shows Operating profit margin for Real estate development in 2025: 18.2% vs 25.5% in 2024.

numerical_claims.claim: Secured order book increased by 37.1% to EUR 466.9 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Key Indicators table shows Order book (million EUR) for 2025: 466.9 vs 340.6 in 2024. Increase calculation: ((466.9 - 340.6) / 340.6) * 100 = 37.1%.

numerical_claims.claim: Joint venture contributions of approximately EUR 10.4 million to net profit, representing about one quarter of total net profit.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 20 shows Profit from joint ventures for 2025: 10,381 thousand EUR (10.381M). Net profit for 2025: 39,918 thousand EUR (39.918M). 10.381M / 39.918M = 26%, which is 'about one quarter' as stated.

numerical_claims.claim: Proposed dividend distribution of EUR 22.1 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 13 states: 'In cooperation with the Supervisory Board, the Management Board proposes to pay the shareholders EUR 22,125 thousand as dividends...'
